first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Rougemont Castle, Exeter, from a source that actually publishes the footprint, or official evidence of a later substantive amendment accompanied by a mapped polygon. Historic England's official List-entry guidance states that buildings listed before April 2011 are generally denoted by a small blue triangle that may not be centred on the building, while buildings added after April 2011 are denoted by a blue polygon. Rougemont Castle was first listed on 29 January 1953 in the already-verified lineage evidence; this guidance therefore does not establish a record-level physical footprint polygon for the legacy entry, so no individual building record was accepted.
